stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) has equation \(2x + 3y = 18\). Line \(m\) is parallel to line \(\ell\) and passes through the point \((6, 5)\). What is the \(y\)-coordinate of the \(y\)-intercept of line \(m\)?
solution: Parallel lines have the same slope, so line \(m\) is \(2x + 3y = c\) for some constant \(c\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
c = 2*6 + 3*5
b = solve(Eq(2*0 + 3*y, c), y)[0]
assert b == 9
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [b]
